_about: Additions to MSA_Criteria_Final_Taxonomy.json, merged by scripts/build_policies_from_taxonomy.py into clause_policies.json and read by the review at runtime. extra_types use the taxonomy's own schema, so they can move into the workbook unchanged. extra_triggers name criteria, by id, that are unacceptable triggers although they are neither Core nor a gate in the workbook.

NCP-01.question_for_llm: Does any restriction that continues after the agreement ends last no longer than 12 months?
NCP-01.met_when: Any restriction after the agreement ends lasts 12 months or less.
NCP-01.not_met_when: It lasts more than 12 months after the agreement ends, or has no end date.

NCP-02.question_for_llm: Is the restricted activity defined by a specific technology, product, service or industry?
NCP-02.met_when: The restricted activity is specifically defined.
NCP-02.not_met_when: The restricted activity is not defined.

NCP-03.question_for_llm: Does the clause state its geographic scope, and is the restriction enforceable under the governing law (for example, California law generally voids post-termination non-competes)?
NCP-03.met_when: A geographic scope is stated and the restriction is enforceable under the governing law.
NCP-03.not_met_when: No geographic scope is stated, or the restriction is likely unenforceable under the governing law.

NCP-04.question_for_llm: Does the clause leave the client free to engage other vendors, build or buy competing solutions, and operate in any market?
NCP-04.met_when: Only the service provider is restricted.

NSO-01.question_for_llm: Does the restriction bind both parties in the same way, rather than restricting the client alone?
NSO-01.met_when: Both parties are bound in the same way.

NSO-02.question_for_llm: Does the restriction end no later than 12 months after the agreement ends?
NSO-02.met_when: It ends 12 months or less after the agreement ends.
NSO-02.not_met_when: It lasts longer than 12 months after the agreement ends, or has no end date.

NSO-03.question_for_llm: Is the restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the services?
NSO-03.met_when: Only personnel directly involved in the services are covered.
NSO-03.not_met_when: It covers all personnel of a party.

NSO-04.question_for_llm: Are general job advertisements not aimed at the other party's staff, and people who apply on their own initiative, excluded?

NSO-05.applies_when: The clause sets a fee or damages for hiring the other party's personnel
NSO-05.question_for_llm: Is any such fee no more than 25% of the person's annual base salary?
NSO-05.met_when: The fee is 25% of annual base salary or less.
NSO-05.not_met_when: The fee exceeds 25% of annual base salary.
